Sam R: Heads-up - Prospect (HelixPay) wants a short Dedicated POC: streaming with function/tool calls that output strict JSON (they'll validate against schema), EU residency, and CMK KMS. They also asked for a pricing anchor for ~20 concurrent streams, ~3k tokens per request, with occasional spikes.

Priya V: I'll take the security questionnaire. Need a clean line for 'where data is stored' for Dedicated vs Private installs we can paste into their procurement doc.

Ethan (SE): Integration note: our streaming websocket supports incremental function_call deltas. Default SDK buffers until the function_call.complete flag, but you can opt into partial delivery by setting options.partial_tool_payload = true. Quick Node demo below.

Ethan (SE): ```js
// partial tool payload demo
const ws = new WebSocket('wss://api.redwood.ai/v1/stream');
ws.on('open', () => ws.send(JSON.stringify({
  type: 'start',
  model: 'redwood-stream-2',
  options: { partial_tool_payload: true }
}))); 
ws.on('message', m => console.log('delta', m.toString()));
```

Ethan (SE): If HelixPay wants to act on partial args, we recommend progressive schema validation on each delta. There is a lightweight SDK helper you can install to reassemble fragments and run incremental JSON schema checks.

Nina (Pricing): Charging note: streaming does not change token billing; tokens are billed same as non-streaming. For a Dedicated pilot we can propose a 1-month reserved pool + pilot credit. Rough capacity guide for a medium model: start with capacity equivalent to 3 GPU-units for steady 20 concurrent contexts, enable autoscale for bursts up to 40. We'll validate with a short load test.

Priya V: Draft language for procurement: "Dedicated deployments are hosted in the customer's selected cloud region or our EU-hosted cluster; Private deployments are installed into the customer's VPC/air-gapped environment. Customer-managed keys (CMK) are supported via major cloud KMS providers and on-prem HSM. Audit artifacts (SOC2/ISO) available under NDA." Will add specifics after infra confirms region options.

Sam R: Can someone confirm expected latency for first partial chunk? They want to estimate downstream call timing.

Ethan (SE): Typical time-to-first-partial varies by model and prompt shape but expect 40-200ms for initial deltas on short prefixes; for 3k-token sequences you may see steady deltas every ~150-400ms as generation proceeds. CPU overhead on client for partial reassembly is small but measurable.

Priya V: Action items: (1) Priya finalize questionnaire text and attach SOC2 link, (2) Ethan to share the Go + Node snippets and a short perf note, (3) Nina to draft 1-month pilot anchor (include pilot credit + overage terms), (4) Sam to schedule 30-min kickoff next Wed 9am CET.

Ethan (SE): I'll post the Go snippet and a minimal harness for a 20x3k tokens load test by EOD and open a runbook. Recommend eng-ml run the quick spike test to validate sizing.

InfraBot: Runbook created: runbook://helixpay-poc-1799999999 (access: sales,se,security,infra).

Nina (Pricing): Draft anchor idea: "30% credit on first month of Dedicated pilot (up to 200 GPU-hours included); overage billed at standard Dedicated rates. Cancellation within 7 days incurs no penalty for pilot." Will confirm with Finance.

Sam R: Thanks team. I'll send the invite and include this thread in the kickoff packet. If infra needs lead time for EU capacity, flag it here.

Priya V: Looping infra for region confirmation now.

Ethan (SE): Tip for testing: use SDK flag --simulate-partials to validate progressive schema checks locally.

Sam R: Closing notes 1 - we'll reconvene after the runbook + load test.
